talents.name: Improved Eviscerate
talents.description: Increases the damage done by your Eviscerate ability by {5|10|15}%.

talents.name: Remorseless Attacks
talents.description: After killing an opponent that yields experience or honor, gives you a {20|40}% increased critical strike chance on your next Sinister Strike, Hemorrhage, Backstab, Ambush, or Ghostly Strike. Lasts 20 sec.

talents.name: Malice
talents.description: Increases your critical strike chance by {1|2|3|4|5}%.

talents.name: Ruthlessness
talents.description: Gives your finishing moves a {20|40|60}% chance to add a combo point to your target.

talents.name: Murder
talents.description: Increases all damage caused against Humanoid, Giant, Beast and Dragonkin targets by {1|2}%.

talents.name: Improved Slice and Dice
talents.description: Increases the duration of your Slice and Dice ability by {15|30|45}%.

talents.name: Relentless Strikes
talents.description: Your finishing moves have a 20% chance per combo point to restore 25 energy.

talents.name: Improved Expose Armor
talents.description: Increases the armor reduced by your Expose Armor ability by {25|50}%.

talents.name: Lethality
talents.description: Increases the critical strike damage bonus of your combo-generating abilities by {6|12|18|24|30}%.

talents.name: Vile Poisons
talents.description: Increases the damage dealt by your poisons by {4|8|12|16|20}%.

talents.name: Envenom
talents.description: Placeholder talent. Replace with real data.

talents.name: Improved Poisons
talents.description: Increases the chance to apply poisons to your target by {2|4|6|8|10}%.

talents.name: Improved Kidney Shot
talents.description: While affected by your Kidney Shot ability, the target receives an additional {3|6}% damage from all sources.

talents.name: Cold Blood
talents.description: When activated, increases the critical strike chance of your next offensive ability by 100%. 3 min cooldown.

talents.name: Improved Instant Poison
talents.description: Increases the chance to apply Instant Poison by {4|8}%.

talents.name: Seal Fate
talents.description: Your critical strikes from abilities that add combo points have a {20|40|60|80|100}% chance to add an additional combo point.

talents.name: Vigor
talents.description: Increases your maximum Energy by 10.

talents.name: Improved Gouge
talents.description: Increases the effect duration of your Gouge ability by {0.5|1|1.5} sec.

talents.name: Improved Sinister Strike
talents.description: Reduces the Energy cost of your Sinister Strike ability by {3|5}.

talents.name: Lightning Reflexes
talents.description: Increases your Dodge chance by {1|2|3|4|5}%.

talents.name: Improved Backstab
talents.description: Increases the critical strike chance of your Backstab ability by {10|20|30}%.

talents.name: Deflection
talents.description: Increases your Parry chance by {1|2|3}%.

talents.name: Precision
talents.description: Increases your chance to hit with melee weapons by {1|2|3}%.

talents.name: Endurance
talents.description: Reduces the cooldown of your Sprint and Evasion abilities by {45|90} sec.

talents.name: Riposte
talents.description: A strike that becomes active after parrying an opponent's attack. Causes 150% weapon damage and disarms the target for 6 sec.

talents.name: Improved Sprint
talents.description: Gives a {50|100}% chance to remove all movement impairing effects when you activate your Sprint ability.

talents.name: Improved Kick
talents.description: Gives your Kick ability a {50|100}% chance to silence the target for 2 sec.

talents.name: Blade Twisting
talents.description: Placeholder talent. Replace with real data.

talents.name: Dual Wield Specialization
talents.description: Increases the damage done by your offhand weapon by {10|20|30|40|50}%.

talents.name: Blade Flurry
talents.description: Increases your attack speed by 20%. In addition, attacks strike an additional nearby opponent. Lasts 15 sec. 2 min cooldown.

talents.name: Mace Specialization
talents.description: Increases your skill with Maces by {1|2|3|4|5}, and gives you a {1|2|3|4|6}% chance to stun your target for 3 sec with a mace.

talents.name: Weapon Expertise
talents.description: Increases your skill with Sword, Fist and Dagger weapons by {3|5}.

talents.name: Aggression
talents.description: Increases the damage of your Sinister Strike and Eviscerate abilities by {2|4|6}%.

talents.name: Adrenaline Rush
talents.description: Increases your Energy regeneration rate by 100% for 15 sec. 5 min cooldown.

talents.name: Master of Deception
talents.description: Reduces the chance enemies have to detect you while in Stealth mode. More ranks means it is harder to detect you. Rank {1|2|3|4|5}.

talents.name: Opportunity
talents.description: Increases the damage dealt when striking from behind with your Backstab, Garrote, or Ambush abilities by {4|8|12}%.

talents.name: Sleight of Hand
talents.description: Reduces the chance you are critically hit by melee and ranged attacks by {1|2}%.

talents.name: Camouflage
talents.description: Increases your speed while stealthed by {5|10|15}% and reduces the cooldown of your Stealth ability by {1|2|3} sec.

talents.name: Elusiveness
talents.description: Reduces the cooldown of your Vanish and Blind abilities by {45|90} sec.

talents.name: Initiative
talents.description: Gives you a {25|50}% chance to add an additional combo point to your target when using your Ambush, Garrote, or Cheap Shot ability.

talents.name: Improved Ambush
talents.description: Increases the critical strike chance of your Ambush ability by {15|30|45}%.

talents.name: Setup
talents.description: Gives you a {15|30|45}% chance to add a combo point to your target after dodging their attack or fully resisting one of their spells.

talents.name: Ghostly Strike
talents.description: A strike that deals 125% weapon damage and increases your chance to dodge by 15% for 7 sec. Awards 1 combo point.

talents.name: Improved Sap
talents.description: Gives you a {45|90}% chance to return to stealth mode after using your Sap ability.

talents.name: Serrated Blades
talents.description: Causes your attacks to ignore {40|80} of your target's Armor and increases the damage dealt by your Rupture ability by {10|20}%.

talents.name: Shadowstep
talents.description: Placeholder talent. Replace with real data.

talents.name: Dirty Deeds
talents.description: Reduces the Energy cost of your Cheap Shot and Garrote abilities by {10|20|30}.

talents.name: Heightened Senses
talents.description: Increases your Stealth detection and reduces the chance you are hit by spells and ranged attacks by {2|4}%.

talents.name: Preparation
talents.description: When activated, this ability immediately finishes the cooldown on your other Rogue abilities. 10 min cooldown.

talents.name: Hemorrhage
talents.description: An instant strike that damages the opponent and causes the target to hemorrhage, increasing any physical damage dealt to the target by up to 3. Awards 1 combo point.

talents.name: Master of Subtlety
talents.description: Placeholder talent. Increases damage by {2|4|6|8|10}% after leaving Stealth.

talents.name: Deadliness
talents.description: Increases your attack power by {2|4|6|8|10}%.

talents.name: Premeditation
talents.description: When used, adds 2 combo points to your target. You must add to or use those combo points within 10 sec or the combo points are lost.
